The deterministic survivor rule is chosen so TS reproduces SQL's shots_pkey behaviour for the realistic replay (earliest-captured row is the one the server stored first) while being order-independent for any multiset; timestamps are parsed to integer microseconds with half-even rounding matched against a live PostgreSQL 16 probe; ordering uses UTF-16 code-unit comparison = PostgreSQL collate "C".
